facility.name: Diverse Genesis Early Childhood Development
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Non_Exact match: 2159 50TH ST, LUBBOCK, TX, 79412

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Medicine was observed still placed on a desk that was accessible to children in care along with another item that stated, "Keep out ouf Reach of Children". The mop bucket with water and cleaning solution was observed empty. Broken toys were observed in the play area that posed a pinching hazard to children, however, the children have not been outside due to weather discretion of director.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Three children's files reviewed were missing the emergency medical authoization information as well as information relevant to the child attending school or not.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: A child file was reviewed and did not have the current immunizations in file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985): A caregiver employed was missing both required affidavits, form 2985 and form 2912, and did not have them for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.1105(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Two children who have been in care longer than 12 months did not have a health statement in file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: One child's file was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §746.801(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Medicine was observed placed on a desk that was accessible to children in care. A mop bucket with water and cleaning solution was observed in an area that children have access to when walking to go outside. Broken toys were observed in the play area that posed a pinching hazard to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Two groups of children were observed unsupervised as the one staff that was present  was not in the classroom with the children and was in the desk area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records: The playground maintenance checklist were evaluated and the operation was able to provide a checklist being completed in a week in December 2025 and January 2026 as well as February 2026. This is in compliance.    The emergency practices form for the physical year of 2025 was available for review. The procedures for ensuring that the number of required safety drills for the physical year of 2026 were discussed and there is a plan in place.     A letter showing that the operation does not have gas and therefore, does not require a gas inspection was not available upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: A caregiver employed did not have proof of orientation in file. **This was corrected at inspection when the director and the staff completed orientation using the form 2947.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Three staff files were reviewed: One staff did not have current First Aid training as it expired in 6/2025. Two staff had CPR training that was obtained online only, however, this training requires hands-on skill-based instruction, practice, and testing. The third staff did not have CPR and First Aid training available for review upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A group of children was observed being left unsupervised as the one staff that was present left the classroom to complete a diaper change on a diaper changing station that was not in the classroom. The classroom had an available diaper changing station in the classroom but was not used.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver was observed doing a diaper change for a child and not washing hands after completing the task.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: Background check conditions were not being followed for one caregiver that had specific conditions to not be left in charge of the operation. This caregiver was observed at inspection being the only individual present on the premise of the operation after the director left.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The last children's product certification form was completed on 6/1/2023 and is required to be completed annually.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: There was no fire inspection available for review upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records: The playground maintenance checklist records were not available the months of January 2026 and December 2025 and only had February 2026 available. Therefore, the last three months were not available.    The required safety drills required to be practiced and documented for 2025 for not available for review as well as the practice of the fire drill for January 2026.    A letter showing that the operation does not have gas and therefore, does not require a gas inspection was not available upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Children were observed laying down for nap but none of the cots were labeled or marked showing which child was assigned to what cot.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One child's immunizations were not available for review at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A child had a diaper change completed and did not wash hands after this was completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: Staff did not sanitize a diaper changing mat after completing a diaper change for a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Posting of Activity Plan: No activity plan was posted for the school-age children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting of Activity Plan (26 TAC §746.2209)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: One staff did not have a file available for review upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: Personnel records were not availalble for review by licensing during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - No Foods That Present Choking Risk: Toddlers were given several types of foods which are considered choking hazards during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - No Foods That Present Choking Risk (26 TAC §746.3317(7))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: Children's records were not available for review by licensing during the inspection
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §746.801(1))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Food not a reward: It was found that food was being used as a reward with children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Food not a reward (26 TAC §746.3301(h))

occurrences.finding: Posting of Activity Plan: No activity plan was posted for the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting of Activity Plan (26 TAC §746.2209)

occurrences.finding: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly: It was found that the center was not well ventilated during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly (26 TAC §746.3407(10))
